Name: Geode Pity System (Gacha Geodes)
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
Are you desperately trying to finish the museum, but have already spent more time than you feel is reasonable, only to end up with one last missing mineral? Fear no more for those dreadful times are over!

Gacha Geodes modifies the drop rates when breaking geodes to favor scarce minerals and artifacts.
This will still be very much random, just also much more fair and fun.
